title: Earthy Gooey Venezuelan Cabbage Quesadilla
description: A comforting, vegan-friendly dish featuring cabbage leaves, served with a side of earthy, spicy plant-based sauce.

ingredients.name: Earthly plant-based sauce (see below for recipe)

instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and saut20until softened.
Add the mung beans and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add the chopped cabbage leaves and cook until wilted.
In a separate pot, sous vide the tortillas for 30 minutes.
Warm the plant-based cheese in the microwave until melted.
Assemble the quesadilla by placing the mung bean and cabbage mixture onto one tortilla, topping with cheese and the second tortilla, and cooking in the skillet until crispy and melted.
Serve immediately with a side of earthly plant-based sauce.
To make the sauce, combine 1/4 cup of soy sauce, 1/4 cup of apple cider vinegar, 1 tablespoon of smoked paprika, and 1 teaspoon of garlic powder in a small bowl. Stir to combine.
